title: Guestbook
description: An append-only guestbook anyone can sign. The smallest end-to-end blueprint: one contract, one write function, and paged reads for the UI.
prompts: Build an onchain guestbook where visitors leave a message
Make a simple dApp so I can try deploying to Avalanche
A wall where people post short messages that stay forever

params.name: firstMessage
params.description: Message for the optional smoke-test entry

prerequisites: Native gas on the target chain for the signer (Fuji AVAX from the Builder Hub faucet)

contracts.name: Guestbook
contracts.description: Append-only list of signed messages with paged reads

review: Messages stay capped at MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES, so a single entry cannot make page reads expensive.
The frontend renders messages as plain text, never HTML: entries are user-controlled and permanent.

frontend.summary: Leave a message on the wall and read what others wrote, live.
audience: Visitors leaving a short public message
journeys: Read the wall without a wallet: newest messages first, author shortened, time ago, and 'Load older' at the bottom.
Write a message with a live 'characters left' count (the limit is in bytes, so count bytes) and 'Sign the guestbook'.
See your message appear at once, marked pending until it confirms.
New messages from others appear at the top without a refresh.
flows: Load the newest page with latest(0, 20) and fetch older pages by increasing the offset; a page holds at most 50 entries.
Sign with sign(message) and show the new entry optimistically until the Signed event arrives.
Validate length in bytes, not characters: an emoji is 4 bytes of the 280-byte limit.
Watch the Signed event for live updates instead of polling count().
